title: Grade 2 Math — Mon, Jun 01
description: 3D Solid Shapes — Day 1 of 5: Naming solids around us
subject: mathematics

questions.question: Which shape looks like a ball?
questions.explanation: A ball is round all over — that is a sphere.

questions.question: An ice-cream cone is shaped like a ___.
questions.explanation: A cone has a round bottom and a pointy top, just like an ice-cream cone.

questions.question: A dice (number cube) is the shape of a ___.
questions.explanation: A dice has 6 equal flat square faces — it is a cube.

questions.question: Which everyday object is shaped like a cylinder?
questions.explanation: A tin can has two flat round ends and a curved side — that is a cylinder.

questions.question: Which of these is a 3D (solid) shape?
questions.explanation: Circle, square and triangle are flat (2D). A cube is a solid you can hold — it is 3D.

questions.question: A birthday cap is shaped like a ___.
questions.explanation: A birthday cap is wide at the bottom and pointy at the top — a cone.

questions.question: A brick is most like which solid shape?
questions.explanation: A brick is a box shape with flat rectangular faces — a cuboid.

questions.question: Which shape can roll easily?
questions.explanation: A sphere is round all over, so it rolls in any direction.

questions.question: The Sun and the Moon look like which solid shape?
questions.explanation: They look round like a ball — a sphere.

questions.question: Which object is shaped like a cube?
questions.explanation: A sugar cube has 6 equal square faces — it is a cube.

questions.question: A pencil (before sharpening) is most like a ___.
questions.explanation: A long round pencil body is a cylinder.

questions.question: Which solid shape has a pointy tip (vertex) at the top?
questions.explanation: A cone narrows to a single point at the top.

questions.question: A matchbox is the shape of a ___.
questions.explanation: A matchbox is a box with rectangular faces — a cuboid.

questions.question: Which of these solids has NO flat face at all?
questions.explanation: A sphere is curved everywhere with no flat face.

questions.question: A glass tumbler is closest to which shape?
questions.explanation: A tumbler has round flat ends and a curved side — a cylinder.
